from cyhole.birdeye import Birdeye

# Initialize Birdeye (API key from BIRDEYE_API_KEY env var, or pass explicitly)

token_address = "EPjFWaJy47gHeQZyRI2ZHfqrqXjsYecTbjfuqVeUVbf"

# Fetch current token overview synchronously
